issues.detail: The Hebrew 'וַיִּפְתַּח אֶת רַחְמָהּ' means 'opened her womb' (i.e., made her fertile), but the Vietnamese renders it as 'mở rộng lòng trắc ẩn của nàng' ('opened wide her compassion/mercy'), which changes the meaning from physical fertility to emotional compassion. This is a substantive mistranslation.
